$comment: Static storefront images: what the optimiser generates and the budgets every file in apps/web/public must meet. Run `pnpm images:optimise` after adding or replacing a source; `pnpm images:check` (and tests/unit/StaticImageBudget.test.ts) fail when a file is over budget or a generated variant is missing. Uploaded media (/uploads) has its own rendition pipeline in the API and is not covered here.
